text: The UEBA system flagged MJA2380's activity for the week of 2011-W02 due to unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients and overall activity volume far outside the same-role peer distribution. Specifically, MJA2380 sent 60.10 MB of email attachments, which is clearly above their usual range of 23.15 MB and above the peer range of 8.63 MB. Additionally, they sent file operations to external recipients at an alarming rate, with 51 operations, which is far above their usual range of 13 and above the peer range of 1.
